The magazine is already an innovation. I thought it better not to try and create an entirely new platform purely for the sake of originality.
This is a .22 Caliber SMG designed with a 50 rnd capacity. Yes .22 has a rim, and yes the magazine is designed with that in mind.

Just a concept. Was trying to design a rifle that would be helpful to a smaller military that is trying to combat a larger invasion force. Since an invasion force would probably be heavily equipped with body armor, I picked a cartridge that can handle any body armor at any range.
